packageRules.description: Automerge minor/patch updates and pinned versions for devDependencies

Automerge digest bumps for the devcontainer image and Dockerfile syntax. Pinning these by digest means base-image security rebuilds now arrive as PRs instead of silently; an unreviewed queue of those is worse than the floating tag they replaced, so take them automatically once CI is green.
Group Serenity/JS package updates to prevent PR noise
Group WebdriverIO package updates to prevent PR noise
